descriptionHtml:
Antec AX90 ARGB Mid Tower Gaming Case + Antec 750W 80 Plus Gold Semi-Modular Power Supply Bundle (High-Airflow Mesh Panel / 4x Pre-Installed ARGB Fans / Tempered Glass Side Panel / 3-Year Warranty)

Maximize your system airflow and energy efficiency with this premium gaming combo available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a 3-Year Warranty (ضمان 3 سنوات). The Antec AX90 ARGB Mid Tower Case features a high-airflow mesh front panel, built-in ARGB control hub, and 4 pre-installed 120mm ARGB fans (3 Front + 1 Rear), bundled with an Antec 750W 80 Plus Gold Semi-Modular Power Supply for clean cable management and ultra-reliable power delivery.
